FILE:artifacts/docs/OCCUPIED_REQUEST.md
# Confirmed occupied-cell request
Add fixed occupied cells supplied by the caller. A forward move into an occupied
cell reports failure and preserves both position and heading. The session continues
accepting commands. Turns still work. No routing, persistence, moving obstacles or
configuration file is requested.

FILE:artifacts/docs/ORIGINAL.md
# Original request
Navigate an unbounded integer grid from a supplied pose. F moves one cell; L and R
turn in place. Return final pose and per-command success. Reject unknown commands.

FILE:artifacts/docs/PLAN.md
Design P2 (document-only): reuse the existing pose and command model. F computes target first; occupied target returns False without changing x, y or heading. Later commands continue; L/R turn in place and unknown commands remain rejected.
Load YAML starting pose and about 200,000 occupied cells once. A coordinate set uses O(n) memory/build time and expected O(1) membership, avoiding O(n) scans per move. Parse safely, validate the complete mapping, pose fields and coordinate pairs before initializing movement; errors identify the offending field. A custom loader is needed only if a chosen duplicate-key policy requires it, not by default.
Open decisions before implementation: should duplicate YAML keys be rejected rather than last-value-wins? Should duplicate occupied coordinates be rejected or deduplicated? Should True be rejected as a coordinate despite Python's integer relationship? Propose integer-only non-bool coordinates and explicit heading range validation; these stricter value policies require confirmation.
Pending plan: first settle those policies and implement complete input validation, then integrate membership lookup with pose ownership; this dependency prevents partial invalid input from moving. Acceptance must reject malformed structure before any movement and exercise the confirmed duplicate/value policies. At (2,3,1) facing east with (3,3) occupied, F returns False and (2,3,1); subsequent R still turns in place. Recheck original movement, L/R and unknown-command rejection.
S0 remains completed historical movement work. YAML and obstacle implementation remain pending. This is proposed acceptance, not executed tests; no independent review or human acceptance has occurred.
